International expansion through partnerships is a piece of that strategy. The company said it chose the Monterrey area because of its "strong economy, growing population and status as one of [Mexico's] leading business and innovation hubs." The new restaurant will feature the same menu as its existing U.S. locations. Chipotle and Alsea signed the Mexico development agreement last year as the U.S. chain breaks into the market.
